name: upload
description: An upward arrow rising above an open sending tray in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The arrow is centered at x=12 above a straight-sided U tray. The tray has a horizontal base and open top, preserving the recognizable receiving/sending object instead of a surrounding frame. Total centerline bounds x=4..20/y=3.5..20.5 balance visible padding 3.15 horizontally and 2.65 vertically. The 1.70 stroke supplies consistent rounded tray joints and free ends. Filled line contours are constructed as the union of radius-.85 segment capsules, matching the native Regular 1.70 stroke exterior, free-end caps and round joins. For closed objects, the body remains solid with explicitly authored negative-space details. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 4 draft awaiting owner review. Owner requested visibly rounded arrow bends across all arrow-bearing icons. The old sharp V is replaced by a tangent circular centerline arc of radius1.50 centered at12 5, with straight tangent arms. Preserve the prior free endpoints, shaft, native visible bounds, centering and Regular1.70 weight. The visible outer bend radius is2.35 and inner bend radius .65; free caps remain .85. Filled is the exact analytical1.70 stroke band around this rounded head, unioned with its separate shaft where present. Transfer trays stay unchanged. This is actual centerline rounding, not only a round stroke join. Both styles remain drafts awaiting owner review.
